meta.name: og-image-design
meta.description: Open Graph and social sharing image design with platform specs, text placement, and branding. Covers OG meta tags, Twitter cards, LinkedIn previews, and dynamic generation. Use for: social sharing images, blog thumbnails, link previews, social cards. Triggers: og image, open graph, social sharing image, twitter card, social card, link preview image, og meta, sharing preview, social thumbnail, meta image, og:image, twitter:image, linkedin preview

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计社交媒体分享图片与链接预览图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网页生成美观的社交分享预览图
copy.tagline_en: Design social sharing images and link previews
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create attractive social sharing images for your web pages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的要求，使用 HTML 转图片或 AI 生成图片，设计符合各平台尺寸和规范的社交分享图（如 Open Graph 图片、Twitter 卡片、LinkedIn 预览图），并输出对应的 OG 元标签代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“OG 图片”、“社交分享图”、“Twitter 卡片”、“链接预览图”等关键词，或要求设计博客缩略图、社交卡片时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张博客分享用的 OG 图片，标题是“如何将构建时间缩短 80%”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can design social sharing images (Open Graph, Twitter cards, LinkedIn previews) using HTML-to-image or AI generation, following platform specs, and output corresponding OG meta tags.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'OG image', 'social sharing image', 'Twitter card', 'link preview image', or ask for blog thumbnails or social cards.

say_en.text: Design an OG image for a blog post titled 'How We Reduced Build Times by 80%'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a 1200x630 image and meta tags.

say_en.text: Create a Twitter card for a product launch titled 'DataFlow 2.0 is Now Available'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an image following Twitter card specs.
